JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Mission briefing · optional, and not authentic

Twelve narrated boards walk you through the whole mission, from the pad to the valley floor and home, with a 1:60 model of the Saturn V that runs through its staging. An astronaut knows what will happen.

In the headset: trigger or A for the next board, B or X to go back. On the last board the trigger takes you to the launch. On this screen: arrow keys or the buttons; drag to look round.

Chapter 1: Launch · The Moon
